Please align for the site intervention, as we have analyzed the logs and found an issue with the IMD_BC2. The logs show the message, 'Relay connection to PLC not checked.' We need to check all the wiring related to the IMD_BC2 and ensure the spares are available in case the component is damaged, so we can replace it in one go.
MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1 (BC2)
Please check the wiring that is highlighted and underlined in the snapshot below.
Please check the +F05-XD42 & XD41 terminals as well for the 24VDC supply to the IMD.
Check the wirings as well that are connected to K4 module.

Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "

eMobility RC-AE SI E Queue (Level 2)
